newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE board to meet, chairman due for reelection.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE board to meet, chairman due for reelection.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) will meet at 1600 GMT on Tuesday to elect a chairman and deputy chairmen, LIFFE board members said on Tuesday.
LIFFE is governed by an elected board of directors drawn from the LIFFE membership. The board elects a chairman and deputy chairmen on an annual basis.

Current chairman Jack Wigglesworth, of Citifutures, has served two years. Board directors normally serve three years, and a chairman's reselection for a third year is usually a rubber-stamping exercise, board members said.
Last year was LIFFE's busiest on record, according to its 1996 report and accounts. The exchange traded 168 million futures and options.
Wigglesworth earned 63,000 pounds in 1996, including profit related pay and benefits in kind, LIFFE's accounts showed.
Appointed non-executive directors George Cox, of Unisys, and Lord Walker of Worcester, of Kleinwort Benson Group, each earned 20,000 pounds.
